inputs.input_volume: 2x64x64 float32 live-binned from FACET cached events
inputs.event_patches: 8x2x16x16 float32 live-derived from input_volume and previous pre_state
inputs.pre_state: [x,y,a,b,angle] in 64x64 event coordinates from the previous row in the same subject/eye/session

notes: This config records the HBTXR-matched training contract before implementation of the final EX-Gaze training loop.
The original EX-Gaze config uses a patch preprocessor. This adapted contract keeps the original pre-state patch logic but fixes event patches to 8x2x16x16 from a 2x64x64 event volume.
Samples without a previous row in the same subject/eye/session are excluded from EX-Gaze tracking pairs.
